title: Two reps, the remove x and removing Parts look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-12-n1-two.png" (board 1.12), "card-13-n1-remove-tip.png" (board 1.13) and "card-14-n1-removed.png" (board 1.14) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and Labor reads {Sales-rep-B} and Parts reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the card with the picture of board 1.12.
  2. Hover over the remove x and compare with the picture of board 1.13.
  3. Click the remove x and compare with the picture of board 1.14.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Labor {Sales-rep-B} and Parts {Sales-rep-A} as plain text, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the remove x shows a light fill and the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Parts", as in the picture.
  • Step 3: one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-B} (the Labor person), with the + back, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R8: “A remove x sits to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", in the column the + uses: the same Tertiary button, 32px square, showing the Lucide x icon at 20px, grey at rest with a light fill on hover.”
  • S2-R9: “Hovering the remove x shows the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.12 Two reps; 1.13 Hover the remove x; 1.14 Parts removed: the Labor person stays (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-12-n1-two.png, card-13-n1-remove-tip.png, card-14-n1-removed.png.

  • Design — board 1.12 title: “1.12 Two reps”
  • Design — board 1.12 note: “Daniel Montoya sold the labor, Becky Gonzales the parts. On the invoice and in Sales By Representative, each gets only their own side; shop supplies ride with Labor.”
  • Design — board 1.13 title: “1.13 Hover the remove x”
  • Design — board 1.13 note: “Tooltip: "Remove Sales Representative - Parts". With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70).”
  • Design — board 1.14 title: “1.14 Parts removed: the Labor person stays”
  • Design — board 1.14 note: “Removing the Parts row leaves the Labor person, Daniel Montoya, as the one Sales Representative for the whole job (decision 66). Becky is not put back.”
